description: This file defines the ProcessSnapshotParser class, which is responsible for parsing process snapshot data from Android VM trace files. It extracts process ID, timestamp, command line, and associated thread snapshots from the input lines.

classes.name: ProcessSnapshotParser
classes.description: A parser for processing VM trace snapshots of processes, extracting process info and threads.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses lines to extract process snapshot information including threads, process ID, timestamp, and command line.
